name: Accelerate Pre-College Programs, Boston campus (Northeastern)
what_you_do: Live in a residence hall on or near Northeastern's campus for twelve days. You take a college style program, mostly led by Northeastern faculty. Academic days run from about 9 a.m. to 4:30 p.m.
who_can_apply: High school rising juniors and seniors from the US and around the world. (The 17 or older rule on the page applies only to the London program.)
pay_detail: Summer 2027 tuition is $6,995 and includes tuition, course materials, housing, meals and social activities. Need based financial aid is available, and a non-refundable deposit of 20 percent of tuition (after aid and discounts) holds your spot. Priority round applicants get a $500 discount.
duration: Twelve days, move in on Sunday and move out the following Friday. Summer 2027 session dates were not posted on the pages read.
deadline_text: The page says Summer 2027 applications open in early December. Priority deadline January 15, regular February 28 and late March 15, each at 11:59 p.m. Eastern. The page does not print the year with these three dates. Deposit deadlines are February 18 (priority), April 1 (regular) and April 15 (late), and full tuition is due May 1.
how_to_apply: Send in the online application. Add an unofficial high school transcript or report card. Add a personal statement of up to 250 words. A teacher or counselor reference is optional. You ask for financial aid inside the application.
notes: Expensive. The program page says the Summer 2027 offerings were still being finalized and will be posted later this fall. For a free Northeastern option for Massachusetts juniors see the Young Scholars Program card.
